## Disposition Legend

- `keep_wrapper`: Script is acceptable as shell wrapper
- `migrate_to_go`: Should be rewritten in Go
- `migrate_to_python`: Should be rewritten in Python
- `grandfathered_needs_owner`: Risky script with identified migration owner required

## Policy Notes

- **Bootstrap exception**: Initial inventory may use `TBD` owners only when `notes=Bootstrap inventory`
- **New grandfathering**: Requires named owner (not TBD)
- Thin wrappers (<50 lines, no risky tokens) are always allowed
- Verifier scripts are exempt from line count limits
- Canonical source of truth: `docs/generated/shell_inventory.csv`
